lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复这条消息吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说点什么？

lines.en: : Cool picture, Nodoka. I understand exactly what's going on and the emotions you're trying to convey.
lines.zh: : 很棒的照片，Nodoka。我完全理解你想表达的东西和情感。

lines.en: : Do you know where I am right now, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你知道我现在在哪儿吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : It looks like the hotel room.
lines.zh: : 看起来是那间酒店房间。

lines.en: : That is correct. It is the hotel room. And I am completely naked and wandering around as if I own the place.
lines.zh: : 正确。就是那间酒店房间。而我正一丝不挂地四处晃悠，仿佛这地方是我的一样。

lines.en: : Is that an invitation? Or...
lines.zh: : 这是邀请吗？还是说……

lines.en: : I wonder if there is anything you could do for me that my little friend on the table could not?
lines.zh: : 我在想，有什么是你能为我做、而桌上那位小伙伴做不到的？

lines.en: : Well, for one, I can talk.
lines.zh: : 首先，我会说话。

lines.en: : And what sort of things would you say?
lines.zh: : 那你会说些什么样的话？

lines.en: : I'm not really the type to reveal such specific information over the phone.
lines.zh: : 我不是那种会在电话里透露这么具体信息的人。

lines.en: : And I'm not the type to carelessly traipse around hotels in the nude.
lines.zh: : 我也不是那种会大大咧咧光着身子在酒店里乱晃的人。

lines.en: : That is very obviously not true.
lines.zh: : 这显然不是真的。

lines.en: : I'm also not the type to tell the truth 100%% of the time.
lines.zh: : 我也不是那种 100%% 说实话的人。

lines.en: : Sensei, what do you think would happen if I were to leave this room in my current state?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你觉得如果我以现在这副样子走出这个房间，会发生什么？

lines.en: : You'd probably be arrested. Or sexually harrassed and/or assaulted if you encountered any males. Which seems unlikely, but still.
lines.zh: : 你大概会被逮捕。或者如果遇到男性，会被性骚扰和/或性侵。虽然看起来不太可能，但还是有可能。

lines.en: : And if I encountered you?
lines.zh: : 那如果遇到你呢？

lines.en: : You're really gunning for cybersex right now, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 你现在是真的在拼命想要网络性爱，对吧？

lines.en: : You're the only one I'd spread the lips of my intangible Internet pussy for. I just want you to know that.
lines.zh: : 你是我唯一愿意为它张开那看不见的网络小穴的嘴唇的人。我只想让你知道这一点。

lines.en: : That is probably the second strangest text I have ever gotten.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我收到过第二奇怪的短信了。

lines.en: : Interesting. The first being?
lines.zh: : 有意思。第一是？

lines.en: : The picture that sparked this entire conversation.
lines.zh: : 就是引发这整段对话的那张照片。

lines.en: : Understandable. Arousal does have a tendency to spark creative genius in me.
lines.zh: : 可以理解。性唤起确实容易在我身上激发创作才华。

lines.en: : But alas, our conversation must end here as the rest of the girls have shown up and don't particularly care for my lack of attire.
lines.zh: : 唉，可惜我们的对话得在这里结束了——其他女孩都来了，而且她们不太欣赏我这身打扮。

lines.en: : Adieu, Sensei. I will be thinking of you.
lines.zh: : 再会，Sensei。我会想着你的。

lines.en: : I don't even know where to start with that picture.
lines.zh: : 那张照片我都不知道该从哪儿说起。

lines.en: : The wonderful thing about art is that a great deal of it can be interpreted in whichever way its audience desires.
lines.zh: : 艺术的妙处在于，其中很大一部分任由观众随意解读。

lines.en: : When you look at that image, what is the first thing you notice?
lines.zh: : 你看着那张图的时候，第一眼注意到的是什么？

lines.en: : That you are naked.
lines.zh: : 你没穿衣服。

lines.en: : Indeed I am.
lines.zh: : 确实没穿。

lines.en: : I am entirely nude and staring directly at the camera. Staring directly at you.
lines.zh: : 我一丝不挂，直勾勾地盯着镜头。直勾勾地盯着你。

lines.en: : And yet, an array of objects fill the gap between us. Preventing you from seeing the one thing you want to see.
lines.zh: : 然而，一堆物件填满了我们之间的空隙。让你看不见你唯一想看的那件东西。

lines.en: : Preventing me from getting through to you.
lines.zh: : 也让我没办法触碰到你。

lines.en: : Do you see the picture any differently now?
lines.zh: : 现在你对这张照片的看法有不同了吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I'm still just imagining what you look like behind the pineapple and...knife. And dildo.
lines.zh: : 没什么不同。我还是在想象菠萝和……刀。还有按摩棒后面你是什么样子。

lines.en: : And...is that one of those evidence signs they use in crime scenes?
lines.zh: : 还有……那是犯罪现场用的那种物证牌吗？

lines.en: : If that's what you want it to be.
lines.zh: : 如果你想让它是什么，它就是什么。

lines.en: : The important part is that it is an obstacle.
lines.zh: : 重要的是，它是一个障碍物。

lines.en: : The picture mimics our reality.
lines.zh: : 这张照片在模仿我们的现实。

lines.en: : There are many strange or curious things keeping the two of us apart.
lines.zh: : 有太多奇怪或奇妙的东西把我们俩隔开。

lines.en: : And you will never get what you want until you figure out how to get rid of them.
lines.zh: : 而你永远得不到你想要的，直到你弄明白该怎么把它们弄走。

lines.en: : Just fucking move them and take a new picture.
lines.zh: : 直接他妈的把它们挪开重拍一张不就完了。

lines.en: : I can't :)
lines.zh: : 我做不到 :)

lines.en: : Why are you hugging a pineapple?
lines.zh: : 你为什么抱着个菠萝？

lines.en: : Obviously because I intend to have sex with it.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为我打算跟它做爱。

lines.en: : There is a perfectly good dildo on the table. And a perfectly good penis on the phone with you.
lines.zh: : 桌上就有一根好好的按摩棒。而且电话这头还有一个好好的阴茎陪着你。

lines.en: : I had no idea you were so talented. Texting with a penis sounds rather difficult.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道你这么有才。用阴茎发短信听起来挺难的。

lines.en: : You know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 你懂我意思。

lines.en: : I do. And, though it pains me to say this as it reveals I am a liar, I am not actually going to have sex with this pineapple tonight.
lines.zh: : 我懂。而且，虽然说出来等于承认我是个骗子、让我很痛心——但我今晚其实不会跟这个菠萝做爱。

lines.en: : Waiting until the two of you are married.
lines.zh: : 等到你们俩结婚的时候。

lines.en: : No. It's simply not ripe enough.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是它还不够熟。

lines.en: : You and I are very similar creatures, Sensei. But there is one glaring difference between the two of us.
lines.zh: : 你和我是非常相似的生物，Sensei。但我们之间有一个明显的区别。

lines.en: : You see, I like my fruit ripe. You like yours...green.
lines.zh: : 你看，我喜欢我的果子熟的。而你喜欢你的……青的。

lines.en: : Blooming, even.
lines.zh: : 甚至还是含苞待放的那种。

lines.en: : And I like that about you. For I, too, am green.
lines.zh: : 而我喜欢你这一点。因为我也一样，是青的。

lines.en: : Hell of a tangent for me just trying to talk about fruit.
lines.zh: : 我只是想聊聊水果，居然扯了这么远。

lines.en: : I'm talking about fruit too ;)
lines.zh: : 我也在聊水果啊 ;)

lines.en: : There's a peach in that very image with your name written all over it.
lines.zh: : 那张照片里就有一只桃子，简直就是为你准备的。

lines.en: : Won't you come eat it? It's unripe...just the way you like it.
lines.zh: : 你不过来吃吗？它还没熟……正合你的口味。

lines.en: : I see no peach, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我没看到什么桃子，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Then you aren't looking hard enough :)
lines.zh: : 那是你没看仔细 :)
